methodology: For every mandatory product, current Administration/Configuration/New Features/architecture/release-specific documentation was searched. Primary lesson selection is based on Fortinet documentation; Community sources are used only to ground scenario behavior.

products.feature_focus: FGCP HA configuration checksum diagnostics and dynamic interface state; compare Configuration Status, checksum dump and HBDEV/MONDEV counters.
products.limitations: The specific WWAN IPv6 checksum bug/fix schedule is described by Community; no official release-note entry for the 8.0.3 fix was independently found.

products.feature_focus: SQLite database integrity checks, workspace preconditions, backup/restore and backup-file checksum verification.
products.limitations: Official docs cover check-integrity, backup and global DB recovery. The new ADOM recovery command and 7.6.10 SQLite fix are reported in a Community article; the official 7.6.10 CLI/release-note reference was not independently found.

products.feature_focus: FortiMQ connector lifecycle, ADOM scope, block_indicator playbook, same-FortiCare prerequisite, FortiGate Cloud-based Fabric Feed consumption and policy enforcement.
products.limitations: Community Node2Shell detection templates are alpha event handlers/reports; they raise detections and do not themselves enforce blocks.

products.feature_focus: FortiSwitchOS 8.0.0 DNS-over-TLS on TCP/853, optional server CA validation, system DNS client scope and cache memory units.
products.limitations: No directly matched recent DoT troubleshooting article was found; a recent SCP-removal candidate was not selected because an authoritative 7.6.7 release-note reference was not independently verified.

products.feature_focus: 802.11be MLO, K-series model/radio matrix, VAP security prerequisites, WTP profile mapping, standalone operation and MLD diagnostics.
products.limitations: No recent MLO-specific Community scenario was verified; current wireless support discussions concerned other mechanisms.

products.feature_focus: Local RADIUS, PEAP/MSCHAPv2, Winbind domain membership, server certificate, EAP method selection and TLS protocol/cipher controls.
products.limitations: The Windows KB5127648 failure is endpoint-side behavior described in the Community scenario; it is not a FortiNAC code defect.

products.feature_focus: Microsoft NAC-API single-host lookup, DeviceID, application permissions, certificate/secret authentication, on-demand registration and random MAC handling.
products.limitations: The recent Community Intune OUI article is categorized under FortiNAC-F but its Scope field says FortiNAC; this is disclosed as shared product behavior.

products.feature_focus: 8.0.2 dedicated Heartbeat Interface, renamed Management interface/Management IP/Management access, cluster and load-balancing modes, heartbeat interval and lost threshold.
new_features_checked: FortiAuthenticator 8.0.2 Administration Guide and New Features
products.limitations: No recent Community scenario directly matching HA interface separation was verified.

products.feature_focus: RADIUS Message-Authenticator generation and response validation, default require-message-authenticator setting and controlled compatibility exception.
products.limitations: No recent Community scenario directly matching FortiPAM RADIUS attribute 80 was verified.

products.feature_focus: Collector HA via VRRP or cloud load balancer, Leader/Follower, VIP ownership, Supervisor job redistribution and process-level failover boundaries.
products.limitations: A recent Supervisor PostgreSQL replica incident was found but is a different HA tier; no directly matched Collector-HA Community scenario was verified.

products.feature_focus: 25.4.b simplified direct-PoP pre-logon, machine certificate CN+Issuer matching, CA trust, allowed destinations, endpoint-profile transition and IPsec inheritance.
new_features_checked: FortiSASE Secure Private Access Architecture Guide
products.limitations: The October 20 Community support case remains unresolved; no root cause is inferred.

products.feature_focus: OaaS subscription entitlement, single-region dual-hub topology, per-spoke license, FGFM management tunnel, agent validation/compare/transaction/rollback and ADVPN shortcut data plane.
products.limitations: No directly matched recent OaaS Community troubleshooting scenario was verified. The report distinguishes OaaS orchestration from previously taught FortiManager overlay templates and ADVPN path discovery.
